t.eng-ummmuhammad: About what are they asking one another
About the great news
That over which they are in disagreement
No! They are going to know
Then, no! They are going to know
Have We not made the earth a resting place
And the mountains as stakes
And We created you in pairs
And made your sleep [a means for] rest
And made the night as clothing
And made the day for livelihood

ayahs.arabic: وَبَنَيۡنَا فَوۡقَكُمۡ سَبۡعࣰ ا شِدَادࣰ ا

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And constructed above you seven strong [heavens]
And made [therein] a burning lamp

ayahs.arabic: وَأَنزَلۡنَا مِنَ ٱلۡمُعۡصِرَٰتِ مَآءࣰ ثَجَّاجࣰ ا

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And sent down, from the rain clouds, pouring water

ayahs.arabic: لِّنُخۡرِجَ بِهِۦ حَبࣰّ ا وَنَبَاتࣰ ا

t.eng-ummmuhammad: That We may bring forth thereby grain and vegetation
And gardens of entwined growth

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡفَصۡلِ كَانَ مِيقَٰتࣰ ا

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Indeed, the Day of Judgement is an appointed time

ayahs.arabic: يَوۡمَ يُنفَخُ فِي ٱلصُّورِ فَتَأۡتُونَ أَفۡوَاجࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: Yawma yunfakhu fee alssoori fatatoona afwajan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: The Day the Horn is blown and you will come forth in multitudes
And the heaven is opened and will become gateways
And the mountains are removed and will be [but] a mirage
Indeed, Hell has been lying in wait
For the transgressors, a place of return
In which they will remain for ages [unending]

ayahs.arabic: لَّا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا بَرۡدࣰ ا وَلَا شَرَابًا
ayahs.translit: La yathooqoona feeha bardan wala sharaban

t.eng-ummmuhammad: They will not taste therein [any] coolness or drink
Except scalding water and [foul] purulence
An appropriate recompense

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ لَا يَرۡجُونَ حِسَابࣰ ا

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Indeed, they were not expecting an account
And denied Our verses with [emphatic] denial
But all things We have enumerated in writing
So taste [the penalty], and never will We increase you except in torment
Indeed, for the righteous is attainment
Gardens and grapevines
And full-breasted [companions] of equal age
And a full cup

ayahs.arabic: لَّا يَسۡمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغۡوࣰ ا وَلَا كِذَّٰبࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: La yasmaAAoona feeha laghwan wala kiththaban

t.eng-ummmuhammad: No ill speech will they hear therein or any falsehood

ayahs.arabic: جَزَآءࣰ مِّن رَّبِّكَ عَطَآءً حِسَابࣰ ا

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [As] reward from your Lord, [a generous] gift [made due by] account

ayahs.arabic: رَّبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِۖ لَا يَمۡلِكُونَ مِنۡهُ خِطَابࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: Rabbi alssamawati waalardi wama baynahuma alrrahmani la yamlikoona minhu khitaban

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [From] the Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the Most Merciful. They possess not from Him [authority for] speech

ayahs.arabic: يَوۡمَ يَقُومُ ٱلرُّوحُ وَٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ صَفࣰّ اۖ لَّا يَتَكَلَّمُونَ إِلَّا مَنۡ أَذِنَ لَهُ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ وَقَالَ صَوَابࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: Yawma yaqoomu alrroohu waalmalaikatu saffan la yatakallamoona illa man athina lahu alrrahmanu waqala sawaban

t.eng-ummmuhammad: The Day that the Spirit and the angels will stand in rows, they will not speak except for one whom the Most Merciful permits, and he will say what is correct

ayahs.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡيَوۡمُ ٱلۡحَقُّۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ مَـَٔابًا
ayahs.translit: Thalika alyawmu alhaqqu faman shaa ittakhatha ila rabbihi maaban

t.eng-ummmuhammad: That is the True Day; so he who wills may take to his Lord a [way of] return

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّآ أَنذَرۡنَٰكُمۡ عَذَابࣰ ا قَرِيبࣰ ا يَوۡمَ يَنظُرُ ٱلۡمَرۡءُ مَا قَدَّمَتۡ يَدَاهُ وَيَقُولُ ٱلۡكَافِرُ يَٰلَيۡتَنِي كُنتُ تُرَٰبَۢا
ayahs.translit: Inna antharnakum AAathaban qareeban yawma yanthuru almaro ma qaddamat yadahu wayaqoolu alkafiru ya laytanee kuntu turaban

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Indeed, We have warned you of a near punishment on the Day when a man will observe what his hands have put forth and the disbeliever will say, "Oh, I wish that I were dust
